items.text: Notice: During spring break week (March 10-14), the Westgate Library will close at 6:00 PM, three hours earlier than usual. Returns may be placed in the outside bin. Holds not collected by Friday will be charged a $2 handling fee. Contact the front desk with any questions.

questions.stem: According to the notice, when will the Westgate Library close during spring break week?

options.A: At 6:00 PM from March 10 to March 14
options.B: At 9:00 PM from March 10 to March 14
options.D: At 8:00 PM from March 10 to March 14

questions.explanation: The notice states the library closes at 6:00 PM during the March 10-14 spring break period.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about patrons who have items on hold?

options.A: They must pay the charge when they request an item.
options.B: They may collect their holds at any hour.
options.C: They are charged for every item they request.
options.D: They avoid the charge by picking up holds before the weekend.

questions.explanation: Since a $2 fee applies to holds not collected by Friday, patrons who pick up their items before Saturday avoid it.

items.text: USED BOOK SALE! Saturday, April 5 — 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Hollis Hall, Room 112. Prices: $3 paperback, $8 hardcover. Bring your student ID. Cash only. Sponsored by the Student Book Exchange. No returns or exchanges. Unsold titles move to the free shelf at 3:30 PM.

questions.stem: According to the flyer, where is the sale being held?

options.A: In the Student Book Exchange office

questions.explanation: The flyer lists Hollis Hall, Room 112 as the sale location.

questions.stem: According to the poster, what happens to books that are not sold?

options.A: They are given away free after 3:30 PM.
options.B: They are returned to their owners.
options.C: They are sold again the next weekend.

questions.explanation: The poster states that unsold titles move to the free shelf at 3:30 PM.

items.text: NOTICE: The bicycle racks outside Kemper Hall will be removed on Tuesday, May 6, at 7:00 AM. Sidewalk repairs are scheduled through May 9. Cyclists should use the racks near the West Garage during this period. Bikes left after May 5 will be relocated to the Facilities Office.

questions.stem: According to the notice, what should cyclists do during the repair period?

options.A: Use the racks inside Kemper Hall
options.B: Use the racks outside the Facilities Office
options.C: Use the racks near the West Garage
options.D: Use racks along the main campus walkway

questions.explanation: The notice directs cyclists to the racks near the West Garage while repairs continue.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the removal of the racks?

options.A: It will last for exactly three days.
options.B: It was requested by the West Garage.
options.C: It is needed for the sidewalk repairs.
options.D: It will be delayed until May 9.

questions.explanation: Because the racks are removed as sidewalk work begins, the removal is evidently required for that construction.

items.text:
Hi Devon,

The Astronomy Club meeting has been moved from Wednesday to Thursday, March 6, at 7:30 PM in Olin 214. Our usual room is unavailable. Please bring the $5 dues for the spring skywatch permit. Reply by Monday if you cannot attend.

Best,
Ravi

questions.stem: According to the email, when will the Astronomy Club meet?
questions.explanation: The email gives the new meeting time as Thursday, March 6, at 7:30 PM.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about members who are unable to attend?

options.A: They should pay their dues the following week.
options.B: They ought to notify the club in advance.
options.C: They will miss the skywatch event.
options.D: They must send another member in their place.

questions.explanation: Ravi asks members to reply by Monday if they cannot come, implying advance notice is expected.
